provenance.measured: 2026_10_18_px4.ulg: BMI088 accel raw rate 1610 Hz, gyro raw 1997 Hz; 1018.param IMU_ACCEL_CUTOFF 30, IMU_GYRO_CUTOFF 80 (user: never tuned). Accel clipping already occurs in normal flight.
provenance.assumed: Full scale +/-24 g and +/-2000 dps (PX4 BMI088 driver settings, not verified against v1.17 source); internal low-pass as a 2nd-order Butterworth at the BMI088 normal-mode bandwidth for that ODR (accel ~280 Hz, gyro 532 Hz); noise densities from the BMI088 datasheet (typical).
provenance.vibration: White vibration std 2.5 m/s^2 per axis at 1600 Hz, chosen so a 5 ms average matches the ~0.9 m/s^2 f_z std of sensor_combined in flight (upper bound: that std also contains manoeuvres). Spikes large enough to clip are NOT modelled; false alarms are judged from the ULog instead.
